notes.title: Free Playtest is coming soon!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676323/54c4fd66f00480015be34260d2cf9177040651ef.png"][/img] Your feedback means everything! Leave your thoughts, tell us what you loved and what to improve — we’ll make sure [b]Hiding[/b] delivers maximum fun.[/p][p]3 maps. Team fights or free-for-all.
💥 Join the free playtest and be among the first to taste the chaos![/p]
